messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — GPU pool saturation in europe-west8. Autoscaler attempted +8 replicas and received quota DENY from GCP for gpu-v100. Severity: P1. Link: https://internal.incidents/6227123456 :pager:
ryan: I’m on it, grabbing context. First estimate: queue length up 4x, tail latency spiking to 1.8s per token.
sasha: Confirming: autoscaler logs show RESOURCE_ALLOC_DENIED / project quota limit reached for region europe-west8. We tried both preemptible and standard.
emma: Customer-facing: a small subset of hosted customers in EU seeing inference delays and throttled requests. CS notified major impacted customer, they reported degraded throughput.
aravind: Any automatic fallback configured? Can we route to eu-west1 or use cached KV prefixes?
ryan: Fallback routing is enabled but policy prefers same region for data locality. I can flip to cross-region fallback to eu-west1 if cloud approves.
sasha: We should avoid sudden traffic shift until we confirm model variant compatibility. Some dedicated customers require EU data residency.
cloud-gcp: Confirmed DENY from GCP quota API: GPU_GPUS (v100) hard limit reached at project level for europe-west8. We have an open quota request but status is "in review" and not fast enough.
ryan: Mitigation options I’m starting now: 1) temporarily reduce batch_size for high-latency routes; 2) enable fallback to smaller model (gpt-medium-quant) for non-SLA traffic; 3) manual scale attempt to use non-GPU fallback nodes.
ml-runtime: Reducing batch_size should decrease queue growth but will raise per-token cost. We have a quantized smaller model ready in the pool (gpt-small-q4). Recommend route 30% of best-effort traffic to that model.
emma: I'll update the customer comms template: "We are actively mitigating GPU capacity constraints; you may see degraded throughput for some requests while we scale."
product-ops: ETA on full recovery if quota increase is approved?
cloud-gcp: If quota delta approved today we can drain queues in ~20-30m. Typical review is 3-6 hours though.
ryan: OK executing steps: applying batch_size overrides to the high-latency route now. Command: `kubectl -n inference set env deploy/autoscaler BATCH_MAX=8 --record`
sasha: Also starting manual warm-up of eu-west1 warm pool and provisioning spare g4 instances as CPU fallbacks.
aravind: Can we temporarily turn on prefix caching more aggressively? That will cut repeated token cost.
ml-runtime: Yes, enabling aggressive prefix caching for high-repeat workloads. Pushing config change to rollout canary 1/5 first.
ryan: Rolling canary now for fallback routing to eu-west1 for non-sensitive customers: `POST /config/fallbacks {"region":"eu-west1","percent":20}`.
emma: CS updated affected customers with a short note. No escalations yet.
cloud-gcp: I’ll follow up on quota request with GCP reps directly. Opening support case and marking urgent.
sasha: Runbook link: https://playbooks/internal/alloc-quota-runbook — step 4 covers cross-region routing and step 7 is manual quota escalation checklist.
ryan: Triage notes: severity P1, impact: increased latency and throttling for EU hosted customers (~7% of requests). Mitigation in progress: batch reductions, model fallback, prefix caching, cross-region fallback.
aravind: If quota blocked >2h we should consider partial degradation mode (reject low-priority requests with 429) to protect SLA traffic.
product-ops: Agreed — prepare throttling rules and pair with customer comms.
emma: Noted. I'll keep CS looped and post any customer escalations here.
ryan: Will stay on this thread until resolution. Please DM if you need direct support. :thumbsup:
